name: Wise As A Serpent
overview: Scripture teaches believers to exercise discernment and prudence in a fallen world, exemplified by Jesus' instruction to be 'wise as serpents and harmless as doves' (Matthew 10:16). This wisdom involves recognizing deception, as seen in the serpent's subtlety in Genesis 3:1 and the warning against false prophets in Matthew 7:15. Christians are called to respond with gentleness and integrity, turning the other cheek (Matthew 5:39) while also prudently avoiding rejection, symbolized by shaking off the dust (Matthew 10:14), all under the protective refuge of God’s presence (Psalms 91:1).
